step1_analysis.description: A current conveyor-based sense amplifier that clamps the bitline voltage to a low, steady value to minimize RC delay. It mirrors the memory cell current from the bitline (BL) to the output node (OUT1), where it is compared against a reference current to generate a full-swing digital output.

paper_reference.title: A High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier for Nonvolatile Memories

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the sense amplifier bias and mirror branches.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Significantly higher than the paper because VREF=0.9V sets a very large bias current in SKY130 1.8V devices compared to the sub-1V optimized 0.18um design.

bitline_voltage.description: Clamped DC voltage at the bitline (BL) during a read operation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the Vgs of the diode-connected NMOS (XM1) sinking the difference between the bias current and the cell current.

read_delay.description: Time delay from the cell current crossing the reference threshold to the output voltage reaching VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 50fF load and 50uA net charging current, dt = C * dV / I = 50fF * 0.9V / 50uA = 0.9 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The intrinsic delay of the sense amp core is very small. The paper's 30ns includes the full memory array bitline RC delay which is not present in this isolated testbench.

switching_threshold.description: The cell current required to switch the output voltage to VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideally equals the reference current applied at OUT1 (100uA).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirror mismatch due to channel length modulation will cause slight deviations from exactly 100uA.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point (power, bitline clamp voltage), DC transfer characteristics (switching threshold), and transient response (read delay) of the current sense amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 BL BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT1 BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 VREF GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 BL N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVREF VREF 0 0.9

* Reference Current at OUT1 (100uA sink to GND)
I_REF OUT1 0 100u

* Memory Cell Current at BL (Controlled by V_CELL_CTRL)
* 1V on ctrl = 100uA cell current sinking from BL
V_CELL_CTRL ctrl 0 PWL(0 0.5 1n 0.5 2n 1.5 10n 1.5 11n 0.5)
G_CELL BL 0 ctrl 0 100u

* Load Capacitance at Output
C_LOAD OUT1 0 50f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  let v_bl = v(BL)
  print v_bl

  * 2. DC Sweep for Switching Threshold
  dc V_CELL_CTRL 0 2 0.01
  meas dc switch_threshold_v when v(OUT1)=0.9
  * Note: switch_threshold_v of 1.0V corresponds to 100uA cell current

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Delay
  tran 10p 20n
  * Measure delay from cell current crossing 100uA (ctrl=1.0V) to OUT1 crossing VDD/2 (0.9V)
  meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(ctrl) val=1.0 rise=1 targ v(OUT1) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(ctrl) val=1.0 fall=1 targ v(OUT1) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
